A '''minehold''' was a family settlement on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Averill]]. Each [[mine-clan]] operated a minehold. The [[Jarrad mine-clan]] had a minehold that produced [[quadrenium]] [[Ore/Legends|ore]].<ref name="COI">{{JournalCite|13|Conflict of Interest}}</ref>
